<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,503><MWT 2>~ Yucan-certified Pro Hunter Course
Opening Commemorative Gift ~

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,3,1,0,2><CV 1,78>I wonder what this box is...?
Inside is 「Pinsleur French
Listening Materials」...?

<TALK 5><NAME 8><CHAR 5,5,10,0,3><CV 11,33>Ooh, that sounds fun.
Let me hear it too!
<NAME 34><CHAR 5,0,10,0,1><BGM 1,0,503><TALK 5>Un nouveau monde s'offre à nous. Merci !
<NAME 35><CHAR 5,5,6,0,3><CV 4,35>On est avec toi. Courage !
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,2><CV 1,90>Huh? Huh?

<TALK 5><NAME 37><CHAR 3,0,0,0,0><CHAR 1,5,1,2,0><CHAR 5,5,12,0,7><CV 17,39>Perdón,
pero yo no os entiendo...
<TALK 3><NAME 38><CHAR 3,7,7,0,0><CV 5,35>Non c'è qualcuno che parla giapponese?

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CHAR 5,7,5,0,4><CV 3,3>Great pronunciation! Now we can
release the worldwide version of
Monster Hunter Explore!

<TALK 1><NAME 39><CHAR 1,3,23,0,3>Hurra!
Kommt, lasst uns feiern!

<TALK 3><NAME 30><CHAR 3,1,103,0,7>What should I do...
I handed everyone the wrong script...

<TALK 3><NAME 30><CHAR 3,0,103,0,5>Actually, the worldwide release is
an April Fool's joke...

<CHAR 3,0,103,0,1>But the Yucan-certified event,
the Pro Hunter Course,
is really opening!

<CHAR 3,0,103,0,3>Do try the Pro Hunter Course
from the Nyan Search Corps.

<TALK 5><CHAR 5,3,103,0,0><CHAR 3,0,0,0,0><ITEM OD_OMA771,1,1>The talisman <COL C70101FF>≪Course Ticket≫</COL>
can be evolved into a <COL C70101FF>≪Certificate≫</COL>.

<ITEM 0,1,0><TALK 3><CHAR 5,0,0,0,0><CHAR 3,5,103,0,4>Then if you <COL C70101FF>attempt the Pro Hunter
qualification exam</COL>, you can get the
<COL C70101FF>Pro Hunter talisman</COL>!

<ITEM 0,1,0><CHAR 3,0,103,0,1>Yucan x Monster Hunter Explore
Pro Hunter Course now enrolling!
<CLS>
